prescripto.name: Prescripto
prescripto.overview: A production-grade, tablet-optimized clinic management platform engineered for a real-world healthcare practice. Currently utilized by Gokul's brother for his active clinic.
prescripto.architecture: Configured with a React front-end interface, Supabase serverless database layer, PostgreSQL relational schema, and custom handwriting rendering engine with Apple Pencil pressure sensitivity.
prescripto.tech: React, TypeScript, Supabase, PostgreSQL, Tailwind CSS
prescripto.features: Real-time clinic queue management, patient vitals tracking, prescription history, handwritten digital prescription canvas.
prescripto.challenges: Synchronizing real-time queue states dynamically across multiple devices while preventing appointment conflicts.
prescripto.results: Deployed live and currently active in-clinic. Slashed prescription processing time and improved patient record lookup speeds by 50%.
prescripto.why: One night, I asked my brother what daily life work challenges he faced. He said patients, particularly in rural areas, often lose their physical prescriptions or fail to keep them properly. This was the spark that led to the creation of Prescripto.
prescripto.problem_solving: Prescripto resolves this by digitizing patient history and active queue records securely online, while keeping the traditional prescription experience alive via a custom handwriting canvas with Apple Pencil support.

hrms.name: WorkSphere
hrms.description: A comprehensive digital workspace and HRMS platform designed to streamline employee onboarding, attendance, performance tracking, payroll management, and department workflows.
hrms.why: With the rise of hybrid workspaces, companies struggled to manage employee onboarding, shift planning, payroll, and department alignment across multiple disjointed systems.
hrms.problem_solving: WorkSphere resolves this by consolidating HR tasks into a single platform: handling onboarding workflows, payroll automation, and real-time attendance tracking under a unified, high-performance portal.

staybite.name: StayBite
staybite.description: A robust booking platform designed to facilitate seamless scheduling, room reservations, real-time availability checks, and customer notifications.
staybite.why: Traditional accommodation platforms suffered from slow real-time sync, high platform fees, and complex UI flows, making booking and room allocation painful for both hotels and guests.
staybite.problem_solving: StayBite addresses this by utilizing WebSockets for real-time room availability validation and automated customer notification dispatches, accelerating scheduling operations by 40%.
